policy: A workflow `uses:` entry must reference the exact reviewed commit for the reviewed version of that action, with a trailing comment that starts with the reviewed version. Floating tags and branches are only tolerated while they are listed verbatim in action-pins-inventory.json, which may shrink but never grow. A newer reviewed version replaces the older entry; the old commit then becomes invalid everywhere.
verification: Every commit below was resolved from the official GitHub API ref for the reviewed version (ref_api) on reviewed_at, and the newest published tag for that action was compared with reviewed_semver so that the recorded pin is the latest reviewed stable release. Re-run tools/dependencies/check-action-pins.py --verify-remote in Actions to re-check the mapping.

dtolnay/rust-toolchain.note: Branch-based action: the pinned commit is the reviewed tip of the `stable` branch. If the branch advances, the pinned commit still runs the reviewed code, so the audit reports the drift as a re-review reminder instead of a blocking finding; a missing or unreadable ref stays blocking.
